title: Agentic Development Training Spring/Summer 2026
summary: A structured training program teaches Business Central developers how to build AI-powered agentic workflows for development tasks. The program progresses from individual developer mastery through three online levels (Beginner, Intermediate, Expert) in March-May 2026, followed by organizational leadership workshops at BC TechDays in June 2026.
key_points: Generic AI tools like ChatGPT don't understand Business Central's AL language, patterns, and ERP-specific challenges; BC developers need specialized agentic workflows
Training is delivered in two phases: online classes for individual mastery with flexible scheduling, then in-person BC TechDays workshops for organizational implementation
Three online levels progress from basic agent concepts and first automated workflows to production-grade coding workflows and custom tool development
BC developers have advantages in agentic transformation because they understand complex business processes and structured environments
